git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 — fix: fix monorepo (initial creation of parseMarkdownBlock.ts). These primitives were never implemented, not a regression.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Initial MarkdownView implementation covered only the primitives needed at the time (headers, ordered/unordered lists, code blocks, horizontal rules, tables, options). GFM extras (strikethrough, task lists, nested lists with indent, blockquotes) and HTML normalization were never in scope.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Extended the custom parser-renderer pipeline with surgical additions for each missing primitive, preserving the existing architecture (no third-party parser introduced). Coordinated capture-group indices with §5.16 LaTeX so both features share the regex without conflict.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Two sources of overage: (1) BA spec required 7 missing primitives across 4 files with type-system, parser, and renderer touches for each — no smaller slice is functionally complete. (2) Quality-gate hook (pretool-quality-gate.py) forced decomposition of the pre-existing 135-line monolithic parseMarkdownBlock into ~12 helper functions before any new branch could be added; this accounts for ~180 of the 373 insertions. Net new logic: ~130 lines. Pre-existing violations are the principal reason diff exceeds 20 lines.

self_verification.notes: TypeScript npx tsc --noEmit reports 5 pre-existing errors in unrelated files (SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx, SidebarNavigator.tsx, SidebarAgentConversation.tsx, SidebarFileView.tsx) — NONE in the 4 markdown files I modified. Ran a tsx runtime smoke test with 14 primitive test cases including Chinese text; all cases produced the expected block/span tree structure. Edge cases verified: ~~~~ inside backtick-code stays literal; nested blockquotes produce correct depth-2 outer containing depth-1 inner; HTML entities decode in every plain-text context but not inside code spans. The fix lands in the worktree; webapp still needs to be rebuilt+deployed via 'docker build -f Dockerfile.webapp --build-arg HAPPY_SERVER_URL=https://api-dev.life-ai.app -t happy-app:dev ${WORKTREE_PATH}' then 'docker compose up -d happy-web-dev' before a live Playwright verification by QA.

recommendations: QA should send a comprehensive markdown test message via the dev UI covering: strikethrough, task-list (both states), nested unordered list, blockquote + nested blockquote, HTML entities, <kbd> element. Verify on BOTH desktop and mobile (390x844) viewports.
Verify no regression by sending a separate message exercising the pre-existing working primitives: bold/italic/inline-code/links/H1-H6/ordered-list/tables/code-blocks/LaTeX.

Since MarkdownView has 7 upstream consumers (conversation, detail panel, changelog, artifact viewer, sidebar agent conversation, TaskViewFull, ExitPlanToolView), spot-check at least the conversation view and one tool-call detail panel (e.g., Task view) to ensure no surprise regressions.

Consider a future extraction of MarkdownView.tsx into sub-files — the file is near the 800-line quality-gate limit and every new span/block type adds pressure. Extracting the style sheet into its own module would free ~100 lines.
